title: Thinking on Ethics and Affording your Morals
summary: Kahran and Divya sit with the discomfort of moral relativism — when does ethical stop feeling ethical, and what values can you afford in a business or in your life? They argue about whether scarcity or abundance mindset drives ethical choices, whether Disney's IP-defense reveals a scarcity worldview about creativity, and how product 'secrets' sit in tension with abundant thinking.

intents.display: to think about what values you can afford to live by
